audit_sections.details: Zero keystroke egress; network calls gated strictly behind user rewrite trigger or browse models catalog
Cleartext HTTP rejected; HTTPS connection required; pinned endpoints for OpenRouter and Anthropic
Dual backup configuration files exclude secret blob, staging blob, and provider DataStore metadata
SecretBytes zeroed immediately in finally block across all provider adapter paths
User-facing notices in Settings, Onboarding, and Readme match runtime implementation per ADR-0005/0009
